_note: Apple II Phantasie II art (v2/5/86; tools/scripts/extract_a2_p2_graphics.py + build_a2_p2_asset_manifest.py, reverse-engineering/apple2/phantasie2/GRAPHICS.md). Every picture is an Applesoft shape (SHAPES) drawn at the game's SCALE / HCOLOR and turned into colour by an NTSC artifact model [~], except the title picture (ICE DRAGON). The Apple's text is the ROM font (not on the disks): the remaster 5x7 font stands in. Screen kept at the remaster's 320 x 200 layout: Apple pictures (280 x 192 hi-res pixels) are drawn 1:1 in it. Map: the Apple draws its 20 x 26 map rotated against the remaster's 26 x 20 grid (FORMAT.md overworld); here the tiles follow the remaster's grid, 22 x 20 cells of 7 x 6. A tile's colour fringes depend on its screen column on the Apple: the pack uses the even-column look.
name: Apple II
_tile_maps: OUTDOORS2 5030-5040: map byte b < 120 draws shape 37 + b / 10 (7 x 6 cell); b >= 120 is fog, not drawn (black tiles 120-255). DUNGON2 5025-5062: only cells next to the party are drawn; 4 x 4 marks: bytes 0-1 wall (31), 185-199 (32), 200-214 (33), 215-217 drawn in HCOLOR 0 (nothing: glyph 0), 218-220 (35), 221-255 (36), every other byte erases the cell (glyph 0); the party is the XDRAW cursor 30. Glyph numbers are the shape numbers.

title_sequence._note: PHANTASIE II (boot program): a text page (SSI PRESENTS / PHANTASIE II / DESCENT INTO THE NETHERWORLD, ROM font), then ICE DRAGON on hi-res page 2 with HPLOT lightning flashing on page 1 (random lines, lines 50-96), then the 'HIT ANY KEY TO CONTINUE' rows POKEd in (243-257) and a wait for a key; a key at any point goes on (line 300). The pauses are BASIC FOR loops (time not decoded [?]) and the lightning is random, so only the last screen is shown, until a key.

_portraits: portrait.{race}: the party figure (TOWN2 2350-2356: races 7+ shape 26, DWARF / HALFLING / GNOME / PIXIE / SPRITE 25, HUMAN / ELF 19, or 27 for a MONK / PRIEST / WIZARD, which a race-keyed picture cannot show) with the arm overlay 20 (idle) or 22 (attacking). The figures by body and pose are in figures/.
